sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Bursting pain, beginning in occiput and
spreading all over. Whole head and scalp feels sore,
bruised, after pain has ceased.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Dull, heavy; pupils contracted; eyeballs
feel contracted: aching in and around eyes. Eyes suf-
fused.

sections.label: throat
sections.text:
Itching in anterior chamber; worse, breathing
any dust; better, indoors.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Decided decrease in pulse rate with
anxiety and apprehensiveness.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Voice husky. Pain in chest, extend-
ing to head. Hoarseness ; constant desire to clear

sections.label: throat
sections.text:
Expulsive cough, deep and harsh. Chest op-
pressed; dry, hacking cough coming on at night and
keeping one awake.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Constant dribbling in open air. Must rise
at night to urinate.

sections.text:
Worse, right side, open air, continued
